body:
Worker rule (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-24 15:53Z; my own slip during Fable2's #630 quiet window).

A coordinator's quiet window ("no new cargo builds or test launches until the gate END") covers compile-only checks too: cargo test --no-run, cargo check, cargo build. Allowed during the window: source edits, reading, rustfmt and tracker work.

Do not run "just a quick compile" to check fixes. Make the edits, then wait for the END mail before compiling. If you slip, report it to the coordinator right away.
